description: Registry of the regulatory bodies that govern tax, company formation, accounting, treaties and banking per jurisdiction — ranked most-to-least important, with official-source links (tax authority, company registrar, financial/AML regulator, central bank, specialists like FDIC, DFSA, ADGM FSRA, Cayman CIMA) — plus the international layer (FATF, EU Code of Conduct list, OECD, DG TAXUD, FSB). Pass cc for one jurisdiction, or international:true for the supranational bodies.

cc.description: ISO alpha-2 (or roster key like MY-LABUAN, KZ-AIFC)

international.description: True to include international/offshore structures rather than domestic-only options.
